headline.text: L1 has *2 unresolved machine issues* — a butter pump waiting on reset and a mixing tank scale reading 22% high — while L2 and L3 each cleared startup delays.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 4 kitchen reported a butter pump needing reset at 04:52 and a mixing tank scale reading 22% high at 05:57; both had maintenance awareness but no resolution by window close.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML3 had tank leaks at startup that delayed depositing until 06:36 after a gasket replacement. FFS and ML2 ran without breaks.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 flow-wrap had a missing roller on the Cavana infeed during changeover, cleared in 3 minutes. MF Matrix is waiting on recipe creation for a new product. Truffle line ran clean.

notes.text: Chad Stone borrowed 6 cans of chain lubricant from L1 for ML1 in L3; replacement order placed.

resolved.title: Tank leaks preventing caramel flow to depositor on ML3
resolved.summary: Leaks on the ML3 tank blocked caramel from reaching the depositor at shift startup, requiring a gasket replacement.
resolved.resolution: Gasket replaced; line purging by 06:12, depositing by 06:36 (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: Missing roller on Cavana infeed belt
resolved.summary: A roller was discovered missing from the Cavana infeed during ML1 changeover, preventing belt operation.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:27 — "Cavanna is good to run now and replaced the missing roller" (Nathan Ruiz).

needs_attention.title: Butter pump on Sollich 2 Kitchen needs reset
needs_attention.summary: The butter pump tripped and requires a mechanic to reset before the kitchen can resume batching.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance notified at 04:58 (Justin Garner); no resolution reported by window close.

needs_attention.title: Mixing tank scale reading 22% high on Sollich 3 kitchen
needs_attention.summary: The mixing tank scale shows a 22% offset when it should read zero, affecting batch accuracy.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 05:57; no maintenance response or calibration action documented by window close.

needs_attention.title: Waiting on maintenance to create recipes for new product on MF Matrix
needs_attention.summary: MF Matrix cannot start production of a new SKU until maintenance loads the recipe configuration.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 06:31; no update on recipe creation or estimated completion by window close.
